issues: Spec mentions exact substring 'TASTE AMBASSADOR CASTING' — page actually renders 'CASTING OPEN · MIRACURL TASTE AMBASSADOR — DINER REWARDS' in the hero eyebrow. The word 'Taste Ambassador' is present multiple times and 'Casting Open' is present separately; a single uppercase phrase 'TASTE AMBASSADOR CASTING' does not appear as a contiguous string. Minor copy nit — not a functional bug.

The Apply CTA is an anchor link (<a href="#apply">, testids rewards-hero-apply / rewards-header-apply) that scrolls to the inline rewards-join-form — NOT a modal dialog. Spec described 'modal opens and closes'; behaviour is correct-by-design but doesn't match the modal wording. Consider adding a data-testid='rewards-apply-btn' alias so external tests can target the CTA consistently.

action_items: Optional: expose a single canonical data-testid='rewards-apply-btn' on the hero/header Apply CTA to match external test spec (currently rewards-hero-apply and rewards-header-apply exist).
critical_code_review_comments: verticalise_text() runs on the public payload, but the events auto-generated by _campaign_events include a hardcoded 'Brand Models announced' title — it is only saved from leaking because public_campaign() wraps the events list in verticalise_text() before returning. Any future caller reusing _campaign_events() directly (email templates, docs) will silently emit salon wording on restaurant campaigns. Recommend moving verticalise_text into _campaign_events itself or renaming with a comment.
PUT /api/super-admin/rewards-campaign hardcodes `doc['id']='main'` on line 228 before the cid override on line 234 — harmless today but confusing; the initial assignment should be removed.

services/campaign_docs.py: agreement PDF now verticalises correctly, but the html email template _pack_html still hardcodes 'Brand Model' and 'Settings → Brand Model Campaign' — restaurant tenants receiving the doc pack email will see salon wording in the email body even though the attached PDFs are correct. Consider a vertical-aware pack_html or a second template.
